blocks.text: Community platform built for creators, brands, and professional organizations

Circle offers more customization than Skool while remaining more accessible than building on Discord. Branded community spaces, custom domains, and flexible space types (discussions, events, courses, chat) let you create a community that matches your brand and use case exactly.

For professional organizations, the member management features are essential. Automated onboarding flows, member tagging, and custom profile fields let you create structured experiences rather than free-for-all discussion boards. This structure matters when your community serves a professional audience.

Circle's headless option lets you embed community features directly into your existing product. Instead of sending users to a separate community platform, the discussions, events, and courses live natively in your app - a significantly better user experience.
Custom domain, branding, and flexible space types
Long-form discussions and real-time chat channels
Multi-module course hosting with drip content and certificates
Live events, webinars, and community meetups
Free and paid tiers with paywalled content
Embed community features into your own product

Circle provides the branding control and professional features that Skool and Discord lack. For organizations where community is a product feature rather than a side channel, Circle's customization justifies the investment.
Our team can integrate Circle into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
